info.name: Appen Platform Account Info Manage Job Settings API

params.name: job_id
params.description: A unique identifier for a job or task that is distributed to contributors. Variable name: `{job_id}`.

params.name: key
params.description: Your personal Appen API key; used to access the Appen platform. Can be found in your [account settings](https://client.appen.com/account/api). Variable name: `{api_key}`.

params.name: job[title]
params.description: Updates the title of the Job.

params.name: job[instructions]
params.description: Updates the instructions of the Job.

params.name: job[cml]
params.description: Updates the CML of the Job.

params.name: job[css]
params.description: Updates the CSS of the Job.

params.name: job[payment_cents]
params.description:
Determines the amount, in cents, that Contributors will be paid per
Task

params.name: job[judgments_per_unit]
params.description: Unit in the refers to a single row in the job

params.name: job[quiz_length_configured]
params.description: True, for custom number of test questions in Quiz mode

params.name: job[quiz_length]
params.description: Number of test questions in quiz

params.name: job[options][req_ttl_in_seconds]
params.description: Set the amount of time per assignment. Default is set to 30 minutes.

params.name: job[units_per_assignment]
params.description: Sets the number of Rows that will comprise one Page within a Job.

params.name: job[variable_judgments_mode]
params.description:
Accepts "none" or "auto_confidence". Use in combination with
job[options][confidence_fields], job[max_judgments_per_unit], and
job[min_unit_confidence] to set dynamic judgments. More info
[Job Launch > Job Settings > Guide to Dynamic Judgments](https://success.appen.com/hc/en-us/articles/203219205-Job-Settings-Guide-to-Dynamic-Judgments)

params.name: job[options][confidence_fields]
params.description:
CML form element name that determines row finalization for dynamic
judgments. More info in the Success center at
[Job Launch > Job Settings > Guide to Dynamic Judgments](https://success.appen.com/hc/en-us/articles/203219205-Job-Settings-Guide-to-Dynamic-Judgments)

params.name: job[max_judgments_per_unit]
params.description:
Maximum number of judgments collected per row. More info in the Success center at
[Job Launch > Job Settings > Guide to Dynamic Judgments](https://success.appen.com/hc/en-us/articles/203219205-Job-Settings-Guide-to-Dynamic-Judgments)

params.name: job[min_unit_confidence]
params.description:
Minimum confidence needed to finalize a row (a number from 0 to 1).
More info in the Success center at
[Job Launch > Job Settings > Guide to: Dynamic Judgments](https://success.appen.com/hc/en-us/articles/203219205-Job-Settings-Guide-to-Dynamic-Judgments)

params.name: job[auto_order]
params.description: Automatically launch rows as they are added to the Job

params.name: job[auto_order_timout]
params.description:
The time in seconds before automatic ordering of any new rows will
occur. auto_order must be enabled.

params.name: job[auto_order_threshold]
params.description:
The job must have at least this many new rows—or the timeout must
have passed—before new rows will be ordered automatically. This
setting must be greater than the number of rows per page minus the
number of Test Questions shown per page. auto_order must be enabled.

params.name: job[ignore_overlapping_names]
params.description: When enabling auto-order, you may encounter the following response message: "You created column headers that duplicate the original uploaded column headers: 'example'. Please use unique column headers or allow duplicate column headers by adding the ignore_overlapping_names=true flag." Ignore_overlapping_names allows a job to be launched where a CML name duplicates a source column header.

params.name: job[options][htl_report]
params.description: Toggle confidence summary

params.name: job[webhook_uri]
params.description: Add webhook URL

params.name: job[options][logical_aggregation]
params.description: Toggle logical aggregation

params.name: job[max_judgments_per_worker]
params.description: Set max judgments per contributor

params.name: job[min_assignment_duration]
params.description: Set minimum time per page (expressed as seconds)

params.name: job[options][reject_at]
params.description: Set minimum accuracy

params.name: job[units_remain_finalized]
params.description: Rows will not order new judgments once they are finalized, even if judgments become untrusted

params.name: job[schedule_fifo]
params.description: Schedule rows to collect judgments based on the order in which they were posted to the job

params.name: job[included_countries]
params.description: A list of allowed country codes in ISO 3166 format (e.g. - ["US", "GB"]) designating countries where contributors are allowed to annotate. Only one of included_countries or excluded_countries can be set per Job. No more than 20 countries can be included.

params.name: job[excluded_countries]
params.description: A list of forbidden country codes in ISO 3166 format (e.g. - ["US", "GB"]) designating countries where contributors are not allowed to annotate. Only one of included_countries or excluded_countries can be set per Job. No more than 15 countries can be excluded.
